title: Family Night at Joplin
seo_title: Family Night at Freddy's in Joplin, MO
description: Family Night is a monthly gathering at Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers where kids get a free kids meal with the purchase of an adult combo meal, plus raffles, giveaways, and activities. It is held for adults and their families on the first Tuesday of every month from 5 to 8 PM, with the first night on December 1, 2026 and the series running through early February 2027. It takes place at 3118 S Rangeline Rd in Joplin, MO.
